name: io.github.techbybuild/vinylscout-mcp
title: Vinylscout — Dutch Vinyl LP & Record Player Prices
description: Live Dutch vinyl LP prices across 15 shops (incl. shipping), LP deals, price index & turntables.

tools.name: search_vinyl
tools.description: Search vinyl LP albums sold in the Netherlands by artist and/or album title. Returns canonical slugs, vinylscout.nl URLs, shop counts, and today’s cheapest price (excluding and including Dutch shipping).

query.description: Artist name and/or album title, e.g. "Fleetwood Mac Rumours" or "Doe Maar".

tools.name: get_album_prices
tools.description: Get full per-shop prices (plate price, Dutch shipping cost, total price), price history summary, EAN, and canonical URL for a specific vinyl album slug (obtain slug from search_vinyl).

slug.description: Canonical album slug from search_vinyl, e.g. "pink-floyd-the-dark-side-of-the-moon".

tools.name: get_vinyl_deals
tools.description: Get today’s genuine vinyl LP price drops in the Netherlands (albums at least 5% below their 30-day normal price), optionally filtered by price range and sorted by discount %, euros saved, or lowest price.

max_price.description: Optional maximum LP price in EUR.

min_price.description: Optional minimum LP price in EUR.

sort.description: Sort order: "discount" (default, highest %), "saved" (most euros off), or "price" (lowest price).

tools.name: list_vinyl_shops
tools.description: List all 15 Dutch and European vinyl webshops tracked by Vinylscout with verified shipping rates to the Netherlands, free-shipping thresholds, album counts, median LP prices, and how often each shop is cheapest.

tools.name: get_lp_price_index
tools.description: Get the monthly Vinylscout LP-prijsindex: median and mean lowest new LP price in the Netherlands, number of tracked albums, and same-album month-over-month and year-over-year changes (CC BY 4.0).

months.description: Number of most recent months to return (1–36, default 12).

tools.name: compare_record_players
tools.description: Compare record players (platenspelers) available in the Netherlands (Coolblue, bol.com, Conrad) with verified specifications and live prices. Filter by query, maximum budget, Bluetooth, built-in preamp, automatic operation, built-in speakers, or USB.

max_price.description: Maximum price in EUR, e.g. 200 or 300.

preamp.description: Only record players with a built-in phono preamp.

query.description: Optional brand or model filter, e.g. "Audio-Technica" or "Sony".

speakers.description: Only record players with built-in speakers.

usb.description: Only record players with USB output.

tools.name: get_record_player
tools.description: Get verified specifications, live per-shop prices (Coolblue, bol.com, Conrad), and the compatible replacement needle for a specific record player slug (obtain slug from compare_record_players).
